ephemeris_source.observer_center: Moon (301), Mean Earth / Polar Axis frame
ephemeris_source.status: The current frontend data generator queries Horizons and verifies the returned MEAN_ME frame and complete sample timestamps.

terrain.source: Local close, near, and far GLB terrain meshes derived from LROC NAC DTM tiles.

visibility_thresholds.definition: Geometric center-of-body elevation minus the terrain horizon at the body's azimuth. Horizons elevation is apparent topocentric geometric output without lunar-atmosphere refraction.

study_assumptions: The baseline is a reproducible study date, not a planned mission date.
The last scenario starts 72 hours after baseline and lasts 72 hours, requiring source coverage through baseline plus 144 hours.
The two sites are Apollo 15 and Apollo 17 landing locations, not proposed future landing sites.
The observer height is 2 m above each modeled landing site.
Terrain horizons are sampled from simplified local meshes within 5 km; smaller features and terrain beyond that radius are not represented.
Visibility thresholds are geometric center-of-body comparisons; they do not model solar-disk fraction, communications performance, power availability, or landing safety.
